description: Convert a ReproIn-named DICOM acquisition into a BIDS dataset with HeuDiConv's shipped reproin heuristic. The scanner sequence names must satisfy the ReproIn convention; this tool does not infer or repair non-conforming names.

dicom_dir.description: Directory containing the ReproIn-named DICOM acquisition.

subject.description: Optional BIDS subject label override passed to HeuDiConv.

session.description: Optional BIDS session label override passed to HeuDiConv.

bids_dir.description: BIDS dataset produced by HeuDiConv with the reproin heuristic.

block.label: DICOM to BIDS (ReproIn)
block.description: Convert scanner sequences named to the ReproIn convention.

requirements: HeuDiConv with its reproin heuristic and dcm2niix; set HEUDICONV to the executable if it is not on PATH
neuroflow/launch.description: Runs heudiconv -f reproin --bids against the supplied DICOM directory, writing a BIDS root under the step output directory.

probe.advice: Install HeuDiConv (including dcm2niix) or set HEUDICONV to its executable.

useWhen: The scanner sequence names follow the ReproIn convention and you want HeuDiConv's reproin BIDS layout.
The study already standardizes on HeuDiConv and ReproIn.

avoidWhen.when: The sequence names do not follow ReproIn: this tool does not infer or repair names.
A person should review series and BIDS names during the import.
You need one NIfTI volume from one series.

preconditions: HeuDiConv with its reproin heuristic and dcm2niix installed; heudiconv on PATH or set via HEUDICONV.
effects: Writes a BIDS dataset to <output dir>/bids and returns it as bids_dir; dicom_dir is not changed.

examples.title: Override the subject and session labels

failures.remedy: Install HeuDiConv with dcm2niix, or set HEUDICONV to its path.

failures.meaning: HeuDiConv failed. Sequence names that do not follow ReproIn are one cause.
failures.remedy: Read HeuDiConv's error in the step log. If the names are not ReproIn, use bidsvue-ingest instead.
